scope_label: consequence of a specified failure mode for a function or affected party
definition: A failure effect is a consequence that may result when a specified failure mode occurs.
explanation: Describe the effect at a stated level, such as the affected component, system, service, or user. One failure mode may have several effects at different levels.
The effect answers what happens because of the failure; the failure mode describes how function is lost, and a cause explains why that mode arose.
